response.original_title: Can I change the room on a Princess Cruise?
response.overview: Yes, ☎+1-866-829-1280(US/Canada) you can change your room on Princess Cruises. You can switch to an available room in the same category, request an upgrade, ☎+1-866-829-1280(US) or submit a bid for a higher stateroom tier. You cannot easily switch rooms online yourself without canceling and re-booking. To change your room on a Princess cruise, call Princess directly at +1-866-829-1280 or reach out to your travel agent. There is no option to change staterooms online once a booking is confirmed. Changes depend on availability, +1-866-829-1280 and upgrading to a higher category will involve a price adjustment. To change rooms on Princess Cruises, +1-866-829-1280 (US) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK) contact Princess Cruises or your travel advisor and request a stateroom change for your reservation. Your request depends on available cabins, +1-866-829-1280 (US) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK) sailing capacity, and booking conditions.
